nodes.asset_description: Right-side light gray paper texture panel with a rough, torn vertical left edge and subtle paper grain; fills the right half of the canvas and tapers slightly near the top-right and bottom-right corners, casting very soft inner shadows along the torn edge.

Cutout portrait photo of a young woman with a blonde bob haircut, light skin, and neutral expression, wearing a white textured button-up shirt and light beige pants. She is seated with her right hand resting on her cheek, looking toward the camera. Soft neutral lighting; transparent background around the figure.
